INSIGHT.SettingThemeHint: The light and sound profile for Insight notifications. Dreadlight is white light out of a black room; Fantasy is warm amber.
INSIGHT.ComposeTargetHint: Select which user receives this notification. Other GMs are included so you can whisper to a co-GM or GM assistant.
INSIGHT.ComposeMessageHint: Only the people you pick see it. A blank line starts a new paragraph; bold and italic work. Ctrl+Enter sends.
INSIGHT.ComposeMessagePlaceholder: The hairs on your neck rise...
INSIGHT.ComposeValidation: Please choose a recipient and type a message.
INSIGHT.SettingSoundFileHint: Optional audio file to play instead of the default procedural sound. Leave blank to use the built-in sound.
INSIGHT.SettingEdgeIntensityHint: How hard the screen edge lights up when an Insight arrives. Full is the intended reveal; Subtle drops the vignette and halves the burn; Off leaves only the card.
INSIGHT.ComposePickSelectedHint: Add the players who own the tokens you have selected.
INSIGHT.ComposePickTargetsHint: Add the players who own the tokens you have targeted.
INSIGHT.ComposePickNoTokens: Select or target some tokens first.
INSIGHT.ComposePickNoOwners: None of those tokens belong to a connected player.
INSIGHT.ComposeSharedHint: Each card names the other people you sent it to, instead of saying "Only you". Needs two or more people.
